courses.description: Introduction to website development using HTML5 from a source-code perspective. Research and analyze business data requirements
Identify and document high-level business rules for data modeling
Create and refine conceptual and logical data models
Select unique identifiers and normalize a data model
Describe the role of SQL in business and database contexts

courses.title: English Composition I

courses.description: College-level, transfer composition course centered on writing essays that say what you mean in strong, clear language, with most writing growing out of assigned readings.
